payload._note: Pediatrix Medical Group provides physician services (neonatal, maternal-fetal, pediatric cardiology and other pediatric subspecialties) through affiliated physicians at hospital-based units and office-based practices across 37 states. The filing states they staff and manage clinical activities at over 365 NICUs in 33 states, operate maternal-fetal medicine offices, pediatric cardiology offices, and other pediatric subspecialty practices. However, the 10-K does not provide a detailed facility roster with specific facility names, addresses, cities, or CMS Certification Numbers (CCNs). The business model involves contracts with hospitals where their affiliated physicians provide services at hospital facilities (primarily NICUs and other hospital departments) and at office-based practices, but Pediatrix does not own or operate the facilities themselves - they provide physician staffing and management services. Without specific facility names, locations, or CCNs disclosed in this filing, no facility-level data can be extracted. The filing focuses on physician network size (approximately 2,620 affiliated physicians) and service line descriptions rather than individual facility identifiers.
